name: Feature-Aware Gradient Computation via Least Squares
definition: A method to compute gradients of scalar fields (u, v, w) by solving a local linear least-squares problem using a fitting matrix Q derived from voxel neighbors, enabling feature-aware reconstruction.
summary: Feature-Aware Gradient Computation via Least Squares computes gradients by solving a local linear least-squares problem, producing feature-aware results that respect orientation and reduce artifacts unlike standard finite differences.
